add_always_draw_imgui.Example:
int gui.add_always_draw_imgui(callback: function)
local render = gui.add_always_draw_imgui(function() end)
add_always_draw_imgui.Description: Draw independently of the Scooby menu; returns a removable render handle.

add_imgui.Description: Draw only while the Scooby menu is open.

remove_imgui.Description: Remove a draw callback by handle.

is_open.Description: Return whether the Scooby menu is open.

toggle.Description: No argument toggles ClickUI; true/false explicitly sets visibility.

set_open.Description: Set menu visibility. False closes ClickUI and ListUI; repeated calls are idempotent.

begin_value.Example: visible: bool, open: bool imgui.begin_value(name: string, open?: bool, flags: int = 0)
begin_value.Description: Begin with an optional close button; always pair with end_.

input_text_value.Example: changed: bool, text: string imgui.input_text_value(label: string, text: string, capacity: int = 256, flags: int = 0)
input_text_value.Description: Edit Lua-owned text; buffer includes NUL, clamped to 1..65536. Callback flags raise an error.

input_text_multiline_value.Example: changed: bool, text: string imgui.input_text_multiline_value(label: string, text: string, capacity: int = 256, width: float = 0, height: float = 0, flags: int = 0)

input_float_value.Example: changed: bool, value: float imgui.input_float_value(label: string, value: float, step: float = 0, fast_step: float = 0, format: string = "%.3f", flags: int = 0)

combo_value.Example: changed: bool, index: int imgui.combo_value(label: string, index: int, items: table, count?: int, height: int = -1)

listbox_value.Example: changed: bool, index: int imgui.listbox_value(label: string, index: int, items: table, count?: int, height: int = -1)
listbox_value.Description: Edit a zero-based list selection from a string array.

begin_list_box.Example: bool imgui.begin_list_box(label: string, width: float = 0, height: float = 0)
begin_list_box.Description: Open a list region. Pair with end_list_box only when true.

get_display_size.Description: Render callback only; current viewport size in pixels.

get_frame_rate.Description: Render callback only; ImGui smoothed frame rate, not a separate game benchmark.

get_frame_count.Description: Current ImGui frame index; render callback only.

get_window_id.Description: Current ImGui window ID; render callback only.

is_any_item_active.Description: Whether an ImGui item is active; render callback only.

color_convert_float4_to_u32.Example: number imgui.color_convert_float4_to_u32(r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number)
color_convert_float4_to_u32.Description: Finite components are clamped to 0..1 and packed for draw-list colors; render callback only.

get_style_color_u32.Description: Validated style color including global style alpha; render callback only.

register_looped.Example:
int script.register_looped(name?: string, callback: function(context))
local job = script.register_looped("demo", function(s) s:sleep(500) end)
register_looped.Description: Register a named or anonymous loop; returning false stops it. Reusing a name replaces the old loop.

unregister_looped.Description: Cancel a loop by name or callback handle.

unregister_tick.Description: Alias of cancel_callback; accepts loop name or handle.

run_in_fiber.Example:
int script.run_in_fiber(callback: function(context))
local job = script.run_in_fiber(function(s) s:sleep(100) end)
run_in_fiber.Description: Queue one yielding job and return a cancellable handle. Errors follow the script error policy.

use_yim.Description: Choose legacy or enhanced Yim GUI overloads in this script.

yim.ImGui.Description: Yim-style GUI adapter; edited values precede changed flags, selections are zero-based.

is_supported.Example:
bool compat.is_supported(namespace: string, member: string)
compat.is_supported("compat.yim.ImGui", "InputText")
is_supported.Description: Check that a namespace member exists and is not marked unsupported. Nested namespaces are supported.

GetWindowDrawList.Example:
DrawList compat.yim.ImGui.GetWindowDrawList()
local ui = compat.yim.ImGui
local draw = ui.GetWindowDrawList()
draw:AddLine(20, 20, 120, 20, ui.ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(1, 1, 1, 1), 2)
GetWindowDrawList.Description: Frame/window-bound Lua drawing object. Obtain a fresh object inside each window/frame; use colon calls with scalar coordinates.
